task.claim:
Let n != 0 and e be integers, and let b1, b2 in Z^2 satisfy
b_i.1 + b_i.2 * e = 0 (mod n) and det[b1 b2] = +-n. Then for all (x, y),
x + y*e = 0 (mod n) if and only if (x, y) is an integer combination of b1 and
b2; i.e. {b1, b2} is a basis of the GLV relation lattice
{(k1, k2) : k1 + k2*lambda = 0 (mod n)} recorded as `glv_basis`.
